courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的水利與海岸設施；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring water and coastal works through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 石門水庫大壩
related.transfer: 可遷移「名目停留時間與水齡」與「颱風入流與短時水位」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；石門水庫大壩的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Nominal residence and water age" and "Storm inflow and short term level" transfer, while hydraulic boundaries, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Shihmen Dam must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦雙曲率拱壩與原水品質取水；石門水庫大壩則以中央心層土石壩與排砂取水協作為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on double curvature arch support and raw water withdrawal; Shihmen Dam centres on central core embankments with sediment and withdrawal functions, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「名目停留時間與水齡」與「分層心層的串聯滲流」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到石門水庫大壩，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「取水孔口的局部流量」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Nominal residence and water age” and “Series seepage through core layers”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Shihmen Dam, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Local intake orifice discharge", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Deji Dam, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 翡翠水庫大壩
history.text: 翡翠管理機關列出雙曲率變厚度拱壩形式，壩高一百二十二點五公尺。水利署回顧記載一九八七年六月完工，並描述基礎岩盤處理的工程背景。教材不使用舊有總庫容冒充今日有效庫容，也不把示範材料強度宣稱為工程檢測結果。美國拱壩方法目錄與墾務局附屬構造索引提供研究方向，沒有取代本地正式規範。與石門土石壩的比較用於說明傳力及滲流機制的差異，而非優劣排行。
history.textEn: The reservoir authority identifies a variable-thickness double-curvature arch dam with height 122.5 m. A WRA retrospective records completion in June 1987 and discusses foundation treatment. The course does not substitute historical gross storage for current usable capacity or present assumed strengths as project test results. American arch and appurtenant-structure reference indexes provide research directions rather than applicable local approval criteria. Comparison with Shihmen illustrates differences in load transfer and seepage mechanisms and is not a ranking of the two projects.
